newsitem.title: CHINA: S&P rates TELCO US$200 mln notes BB-plus.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates TELCO US$200 mln notes BB-plus.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Monday it had assigned its BB-plus rating to the Tata Engineering and Locomotive Co Ltd (TELCO) US$200 million unsecured notes due 2007. The rating outlook is stable.

TELCO's rating reflects its dominant market position in the heavy and medium commercial vehicle segment, dynamic market opportunities, and a moderately aggresive financial profile, the rating agency said.
However, TELCO is exposed to a volatile and growing consumer market, increased competition from new entrants, and a substantial capital programme, it said.

S&P said TELCO's indigenous passenger car project will encounter strong competition from domestic and offshore makers, and its success was constrained somewhat by an underdeveloped components and parts industry.
But the agency said it expects TELCO'S product diversity and proven experience at continual model development will enable successful development of the car.

TELCO is also undertaking a capital expansion programme to modernize and expand production which, while subject to normal commissioning problems, is mitigated by TELCO's strong track record of production line development and model enhancement.
The funding of this programme is via a combination of debt and equity, and S&P said it expects that gearing will remain within management's preferred gearing levels of 50 percent.

The capital programme is predicated on a growing automobile market which has historically displayed cyclicality, but TELCO's dominant market position and product diversity will enable it to assume greater levels of debt to fund it, S&P said.
